scope.description: An observed-interior-portrait direction that connects people through gaze and posture, creates depth through overlapping dark planes and selective illumination, and reserves crisp detail for a few focal features. Painterly looseness remains active around those anchors without dissolving the room.
limitations: Preserve the requested people, identities, count, relationships, and setting; do not add a mirror, doorway, court costume, attendant, or painter figure unless requested.
Use gaze and posture to connect requested people or a person and task; do not force anyone to look at the viewer.
Let selective light clarify the requested scene without turning it into a theatrical spotlight or copying a known portrait arrangement.

rules.applies_when: The requested scene includes multiple people or a person engaged with another subject.
rules.instruction: Use the requested gaze directions, head turns, and posture to create a path of attention among the figures, their task, or an explicitly requested viewer; keep each gesture natural and specific to the brief.
rules.observable: A viewer can infer who attends to whom or what, and the relationships read without added narrative props.
rules.reject_when: All figures stare forward by default, their gazes have no relation to the scene, or unrequested social drama is introduced.
rules.avoid: forced direct gaze, copied group poses, and invented courtly interaction

rules.applies_when: The user requests an interior portrait or group scene with visible spatial depth.
rules.instruction: Separate foreground, figure plane, and background with overlap and restrained changes in value; use a coherent patch or opening of light only when the requested setting provides one, and keep shadowed architecture legible.
rules.observable: Space recedes behind the figures without relying on a black void, a universal spotlight, or an invented architectural feature.
rules.reject_when: Background and figures collapse into one flat dark mass, or dramatic light overwhelms the requested people.
rules.avoid: unrequested mirrors or doorways, blacked-out rooms, and theatrical beams

rules.applies_when: A portrait or group scene has a few clear points of attention.
rules.instruction: Use precise, economical marks for eyes, hands, and focal materials; let less important garments and room surfaces resolve through broader, freer strokes, preserving enough edge information to identify the forms.
rules.observable: Detail density follows attention, and broad passages feel intentional rather than unfinished or uniformly blurred.
rules.reject_when: Every surface is rendered with equal sharpness, or loose marks erase the requested expression and action.
rules.avoid: uniform photorealistic detail, random brush texture, and global soft focus
